# Workshop Extensions - Explosion Sounds Reference Sheet

Source: [2765](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/2765); edited 2024-09-08. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-2765-n2"></a>

- Using Event Player as Position may sound different or produce no sound versus Position Of(Event Player).
